description.value: Silver Dragon Restaurant is a White Rock institution with over fifty years of history, known for its authentic Chinese cuisine, particularly its wonton soup made from turkey giblet broth and its sweet and sour pork. The fully licensed restaurant was honored as the Best Chinese Restaurant by the Now Regional Newspaper in 2003 and has built a multigenerational local following. It offers dine-in, online ordering with delivery, and a Sunday all-you-can-eat smorgasbord.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address and business name. The site explicitly mentions online ordering and delivery, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities is found anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. A discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Tu-Su 13:00-21:30, closed Monday) and the website (Monday to Sunday 12:30pm-9:30pm), suggesting the OSM data is outdated.
concerns: Phone number 604-536-4848 found on website but absent from OSM tags.
Opening hours discrepancy: OSM shows Tu-Su 13:00-21:30 (closed Monday, opens at 1pm); website states Monday to Sunday 12:30pm-9:30pm. OSM data appears outdated.
Booking subpage footer contains a typo ('Silever Dragon Chinese Restaurant') — minor but noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, long-standing restaurant in White Rock with confirmed takeout, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are evidenced on the website or in OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to confirm minimum eligibility.
